challenges.statement: The SDUI payload renders 14 distinct interactive components (including multiple metric tiles, quizzes, reward carousels, and challenge cards) on a single screen view. This represents severe component overload and cognitive fatigue risk for the user.

releaseReasons: Payload violates component density limits by packing 14 high-intensity gamification and metric tiles into a single initial viewport without progressive disclosure.

agentMessages.summary: Component overload detected: 14 complex gamification components rendered simultaneously, violating cognitive load best practices.
